---
title: "Code Highlighting Formatting for Verbatim"
format:
  pdf:
    include-in-header: 
      - text: |
          %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%% USAGE NOTE %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
          % This LaTeX script sets up consistent formatting for DSDE Workshop handouts.
          %
          % To use:
          % 1. Reference this LaTeX script in the YAML header of Quarto documents
          %    with correct relative paths based on their directory depth.
          % 2. Ensure that the "rootdir" and "stylesdir" paths in this LaTeX script
          %    match those relative paths. Adjust as necessary.
          % 
          % The LaTeX script is located in "Code/Handout Formatting/PDF Formatting Script.tex".
          %
          % Example:
          % For:
          %   \input{../Code/Handout Formatting/PDF Formatting Script.tex}
          % Set:
          %   \newcommand{\rootdir}{../Code/Handout Formatting}
          %   \newcommand{\stylesdir}{../_styles/Yale_typeface}
          %
          % For:
          %   \input{../../../../Code/Handout Formatting/PDF Formatting Script.tex}
          % Set:
          %   \newcommand{\rootdir}{../../../../Code/Handout Formatting}
          %   \newcommand{\stylesdir}{../../../../_styles/Yale_typeface}
          %
          %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
          
          \input{Handout Formatting/PDF Formatting Script.tex}
highlight-style: ../_styles/idle-fingers-light.theme
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| echo: false

source("Code Highlighting Functions_Verbatim.R")

# Read all your bash snippets
bash_snippets <- list(
  "branch 'test-r' set up to track 'origin/test-r'.
Switched to a new branch 'test-r'"
)

# Generate all formatted code
formatted <- lapply(bash_snippets, format_bash)
#formatted <- lapply(bash_snippets, format_r)

# Write to a file you can copy-paste from
writeLines(unlist(formatted), "formatted_bash.tex")

```
